title: Limit of the majority plus-bribe threshold
statement: Let $k,m:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and $t\in\mathbb{R}$. If $m(q)\to\infty$ and $k(q)/\sqrt{m(q)}\to t$ as $q\to\infty$, then $-(k(q)+1)/\sqrt{m(q)}\to -t$.
